query:
UPDATE key_sessions
        SET    text         = text || $1,
               app_display  = CASE
                                WHEN $2 <> '' AND lower($2) <> lower(app)
                                THEN $2 ELSE app_display
                              END,
               user_name    = COALESCE($6, user_name),
               updated_at   = NOW()
        WHERE  agent_id     = $3
          AND  app          = $4
          AND  window_title = $5
          AND  updated_at   > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
